s.note: the black goo of the symbiote
s.how: Toss 600g chicken thigh pieces in cornflour and fry until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp soy sauce with 3 tbsp honey until bubbling and toss the chicken through. Roll in black sesame seeds until coated and dark. Serve on toothpicks.

Bake 1kg frozen potato gems at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crunchy. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp sriracha and 1 crushed garlic clove. Serve the gems in a big bowl with the mayo for dunking.

m.n: Lobster tank garlic butter lobster tails
m.note: Eddie jumping into the restaurant's lobster tank
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and fry twice until crisp. Split 4 lobster tails, brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic and parsley, and grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Serve with the fries and lemon wedges. Tater tots optional.

w.how: Dissolve 3 tsp gelatine in 100ml hot water. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with 80g caster sugar until smooth, keeping a few cubes aside. Stir in the gelatine, then 200ml evaporated milk and 100ml cream. Pour into 4 glasses and chill for at least 4 hours until set. Just before serving, pour a little evaporated milk over each and top with mango cubes.

d.how: Steep 4 black tea bags in 500ml boiling water for 5 minutes, remove, stir in 4 tbsp sweetened condensed milk and chill. Pour over ice in 4 glasses and top each with a splash of cold milk.
